unit.why: A short narrative about the Besht (מרן הריב״ש) travelling miraculously to bring back a man who had abandoned faith out of envy, ending in his repentance.
unit.boundary_note: Trailing heading 'מענין קריאות שמות' belongs to the next division; the story is the fifth item in a topical series headed 'מענין קנאה' in the previous division.

stories.start_quote: וכיוצא בימי מרן הריב״ש יצא איש
stories.summary_en: In the Besht's time a great man left the fold and denied God out of envy of his brothers who had become rabbis; the Besht travelled many parasangs in one day by contraction of the road, spent the Sabbath in Radom, and brought him back the same way to his town, where he repented fully.

עד שהחזירו בקפיצה לעירו ועשה תשובה שלימה
